jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pay Range:

The salary for this position varies based on experience, with an hourly rate of $18.00 to $22.70 on offer

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Schedule:

The designated business days for our company are between Monday and Thursday, where we are available for service from 3:30pm until 2:00am

What sets us apart is the exceptional quality of our staff.

As a member of our organization, you'll enjoy a broad range of incentives, remuneration that is on par with industry standards, chances for professional growth, and opportunities for advancement. Our full-time collaborators, in particular, are eligible for:

  • Paid Training
  • The privilege of having both paid holidays and Paid Time Off
  • A 401(k) program in which the company matches employee contributions on a dollar-for-dollar basis
  • The Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) typically has a set enrollment period during which employees can elect to participate in the program
  • With group health insurance, employees can enjoy the benefits of affordable and reliable healthcare coverage, including preventative care, emergency services, and hospitalization
  • Understanding Basic Life Insurance

Elevate your career with our innovative training programs

Job Overview:

The Seasonal Automated Warehouse Package Handler is responsible for completing customer orders. They do so by taking necessary items and quantities as mentioned on a pick ticket or a computer screen. Upon taking these items, they place them on a designated conveyor or pallet. Their performance must meet the company's regulations with due consideration for safety, accuracy, and efficiency.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assisting in the selection and handling of items in an automated environment involves using sophisticated machinery, software applications, and computers while following CCCI's established safety policies and procedures. Your multi-tasking skills, coupled with a quick decision-making ability, are invaluable in such a noisy and demanding environment.
  • Facilitates reliable warehouse procedures through team collaboration.
  • Exhibits versatility in adjusting to the requirements of the role by staying informed about the different work sections within the facility and satisfying the minimum performance criteria of each section, including but not limited to, HQS, Semi-Automated Lanes, Flow Rack, and Pallet Pick.
  • Ensuring that the warehouse functions without complications, you will assist in maintaining a hygienic environment by keeping your workstation free from refuse and clutter, mopping up any drips or spills that occur, and following the waste management and recycling practices as required.
  • Adheres to secure, accurate, and proficient protocols to regulate warehouse inventory and prevent shrinkage from exceeding acceptable levels.
  • To keep a warehouse running efficiently in a constantly changing environment, performs miscellaneous tasks as assigned.

Knowledge refers to the information and understanding that one has about a particular subject or domain, while skills are practical abilities that are developed through practice and experience, and abilities are innate talents or qualities that one possesses

  • Possessing the capability to perform in a swift atmosphere while walking and recurrently hoisting 30 lbs.
  • Aptitude to handle items weighing up to 75 pounds.
  • The aptitude to team up with others in a collaborative surrounding is a valuable ability.
  • Capable of streamlining and systematizing warehouse operations to promote efficiency and dependability.
  • The flexibility to adapt to the needs of different work domains and fulfill the minimum requirements of each area.
  • The aptitude to read and understand instructions shown on a computer display.
  • The capability to be meticulous and to distinguish our packages is of great importance.
  • Proficiency to work in an environment that lacks temperature control with high levels of noise.
  • Someone who is self-directed and continuously looks for ways to add value without being prompted.
  • A work environment that can adjust to meet the changing demands of the industry is referred to as flexibility.
  • The use of screens, monitors, and devices is a crucial aspect of performing accurate picking while adhering to a specific order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • The experience gathered within the first three years of work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Having a high school diploma or GED signals to employers that an individual has acquired basic knowledge, skills, and competencies.

Work Environment:

  • This location presents challenges for workers, as it lacks proper temperature control and experiences high levels of noise.

Our company takes pride in being an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer, which means that we treat all candidates fairly and equally, regardless of their background, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

jobs.description:
At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. We’re one of the largest manufacturers of paperboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world’s most recognized brands of food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care and pet products. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we are collaborative, diverse, innovative individuals who create inspired packaging while giving back to our communities.

With over 25,000 employees working in more than 130 locations worldwide, we strive to be environmentally responsible in our industry and in the communities where we operate. We are committed to workplace diversity and offer compensation and benefits programs that are among the industry’s best to reward the talented people who make our company successful.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you.

A World of Difference. Made Possible.

OPPORTUNITY: We are a Food service folding carton manufacturing operation seeking candidates to join our Chicago IL team. We’re recruiting for multiple positions so be sure you review all of our job postings. This job posting is for a Shipping – Receiving associate with a pay range of $21.91 to $25.36 /hour plus shift differential and progressive pay increases. We continually encourage our employees to advance their careers through on the job training and job progression through our strong promotion from within program. We offer a wide array of benefits including, but not limited to, Paid Vacation & Holidays, optional Health, Dental, and Life Insurance, including health spending accounts and a progressive healthy lifestyle program, as well as 401-K with a company matching component and standard supplemental company contributions. Employees may voluntarily elect Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance Programs, Purchasing Power, Tuition Reimbursement, Aflac, Lifelock Identity Protection, and Hyatt Legal Services. Tobacco Cessation and Employee Assistance/Referral Program, Uniform Service, Safety Shoe, and Safety Prescription-Eyewear benefits are also available.

JOB SUMMARY: The person who occupies this position is responsible for shipping, receiving coordinating traffic, warehousing inventories, communications and producing product and any other items as they relate to shipping out of or being received into the plant and warehouse locations.

JOB FUNCTIONS: Job functions include, but are not limited to the following.

A shipping material handler will spend approximately 70% of working shift on a forklift and 30% doing other shipping duties.

  • Know, understand and follow all plant and department safety requirements.
  • Maintain a safe and clean environment inside and outside of the facility.
  • Maintain equipment and do all required safety checks and cleanings as required.
  • Wrap loads and insure quality standards and checks are being completed this is insuring packing, wrapping, labeling and information is correct on outbound shipment of product.
  • Ship and Receive all product in and out of the plant location.
  • Insure all manifests, invoices, orders, shipping documentation, and forms are accurate.
  • Examine documents to insure outbound and incoming contents are accurate with paperwork of the shipment.
  • Prepare documents such as work orders, bills of ladings, packing slips and shipping orders.
  • Shuttle product from the facility to outside warehousing as need with accurate billing and documentation for accurate inventories.
  • Record shipping data such as damages, rejected trailers, discrepancies for reporting, accounting and recordkeeping purposes.
  • Determine shipping methods and procedures for safe shipment based on the material using shipping knowledge and procedures.
  • Deliver or rout incoming material or equipment to the appropriate departments.
  • Confer and correspond with representatives to rectify problems such as shortage of material, late trucks, quality issues and nonconformance to specifications. This will include but is not limited to the warehouse, other shifts, production departments, corporate transportation, quality departments, safety manager or any supervision of the plant.
  • Communicating with Supervisors, Peers and Subordinates to insure all issues are communicated properly.
  • Store, maintain and monitor shipping materials and supplies used for shipping.
  • Contact corporate shipping (TMS) or supervision when needed to insure scheduled inbound and outbound reach their destinations as scheduled to meet the needs of the customer and our facilities.
  • Compute weights and pallet amounts to insure trailers are loaded properly and not detained over the road.
  • Load product on shipments and shuttles to insure scheduled load times are being met by our facility and the warehouse along with scheduled delivery time of product.
  • Process customer returns and validate all incoming product.
  • Use, know and understand all computer programs and technical skills used at the facility in the shipping and inventory function.
  • Pull PO from file, sign and verify physical delivery of goods.
  • Pull packing slip from goods and validate receipt.
  • Audit packing slip against PO to determine if delivery received is complete
  • Unpack deliveries; verify product received against PO item and quantity. Receive items in SAP. Pull PO (or reprint) and assemble w/packing slip for GR for 3-way filing.
  • Process chemical deliveries consist with established protocol.
  • Act as the backup for all plant subcontracting.
  • Backfill material handler position (breaks, lunches, vacations etc.)

Background / Experience / Skills

  • Manufacturing experience preferred
  • Must have physical coordination to operate forklift.
  • Use of Machines, Tools, Equipment, Software:
    • Forklifts (Reach Truck experience needed)
    • Radio and Communication devices
    • Bar code reader
    • E-Mail communications.
    • SAP
    • PEAK
    • Phone-Two way communications
    • Fax
  • Know, understand and pass all needed skill level matrix
  • Know and understand SAP application in regards to inventory, production and shipments.
  • Know and understand all shipping protocol and procedures.
  • Must have reasoning ability to identify alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
Education / Knowledge

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • English speaking, reading and writing skills and comprehension- This is needed to insure proper shipping, receiving and computer programs are used to insure proper and legal documentation and processes are followed. This will include the need to be able to understand written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents and programs. It includes conveying information to the needed parties and writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.
  • The knowledge and understanding of meeting both internal and external customer needs. Servicing the customers and vendors in a professional manner while supplying prompt delivery and receiving of products to and from the facility.

Schedule Requirements

Responsibilities

About FedEx Ground Warehousing

FedEx Ground hub facilities process millions of packages every night, forming the backbone of one of America's most trusted delivery networks. Package Handlers are the essential workforce that keeps this operation moving with speed and accuracy. FedEx Ground facilities operate in a fast-paced, team-driven environment where safety, efficiency, and reliability are the top priorities.

Position Overview

FedEx Ground is hiring Package Handlers for early morning, evening, and overnight shifts at local hub and sorting facilities. In this physically demanding warehouse role, you will load, unload, and sort packages on high-speed conveyor systems. No prior experience is required — FedEx provides full paid training for all new hires.

Key Responsibilities

  • Load and unload packages from delivery vehicles and trailers onto conveyor belts and sorting systems.
  • Sort packages by destination zip code and route using automated scanning equipment.
  • Maintain a safe, organized work area and follow all FedEx safety protocols at all times.
  • Handle packages weighing up to 75 lbs with care to prevent damage during transit.
  • Meet or exceed hourly throughput targets while maintaining scan accuracy above 99%.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No experience or degree required. Must be able to lift up to 75 lbs repeatedly and stand for entire shift duration (3–5 hours). FedEx Ground offers competitive starting pay, weekly paychecks, tuition assistance up to $5,250/year, and career advancement into supervisory and operations roles.

jobs.title: Warehouse Package Handler
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Target takes pride in its top-ranking position among retailers in the US. Its aim is to make daily life for families as enjoyable and stress-free as possible with its superior product and service offerings.

Roles and Duties:

  • Undertake safety measures and protocols to ensure the protection of every team member and promote a secure workplace culture.
  • Engage in safety training workshops that teach workers how to avoid hazardous incidents while working in a fast-paced warehouse atmosphere.
  • In this role, you will be responsible for transporting goods by packing, loading, and shipping items to retail stores and customers.
  • Guarantee the accuracy of merchandise processing to facilitate delivery to our retail locations and consumers.
  • Operate with caution while also moving cargo and stock around the warehouse quickly and competently.
  • An uncluttered work area can help you stay focused and reduce stress levels while performing your duties.
  • Ensure being on time to work and accomplishing tasks as instructed with precision within the given time frame.
  • To excel at problem solving, it's important to create a culture that encourages employees to identify and report issues. Providing training and resources can also assist in developing effective problem solving skills
  • Demonstrates a courteous and optimistic demeanor when working independently or within a group setting.

Requirements:

  • Capable of regularly handling and carrying merchandise that weigh between 35-50 pounds throughout the duration of a workday.
  • Able to transport goods weighing up to 60 pounds from time to time throughout the workday.
  • Perform actions that involve standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching repetitively during shifts.
  • A positive and respectful approach is crucial to succeeding in both solo projects and team efforts.
  • Skilled in proficiently applying elementary mathematical concepts like counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Demonstrating the talent to effectively read and understand the information on product documentation, labels, and tickets.
  • Competent use of computer systems and handheld devices can be achieved with little supervision after appropriate training.
  • Being a strong communicator can improve teamwork, collaboration, and overall productivity in any work environment
  • Understanding and complying with safety policies, procedures, and instructions require a reasonable level of proficiency in English to read, speak, and understand directives.

Additional Requirements:

  • Competent in handling all powered equipment with proper safety precautions, including Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit-Down, and Standup Forklift, and capable of working at a height of up to 40ft when required.
  • Conduct work operations at a height of up to 40 ft on a mezzanine level, as appropriate
  • Comfortable working in varying temperature conditions, such as refrigerated or frozen environments, for the duration of the shift.

Benefits:

Target team members are offered a range of benefits, provided they meet the necessary criteria and adhere to the terms and conditions of the eligibility criteria.

Note:

The business requirements for the Warehouse Operations position necessitate an analysis of your fitness for either the Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate roles, with your performance in the questionnaire and assessment playing a crucial part in the decision-making process. Below are the prerequisites for each of these positions, and elaboration on job responsibilities for each can be found via links at the end of this page.

About UPS & Our Culture

When UPS says immediate hire, we mean it. During peak season, our package center teams expand by thousands of associates in a matter of weeks, and we have built our onboarding system to get people working — and getting paid — as fast as any warehouse employer in America. If you are searching for seasonal warehouse jobs hiring immediately with a brand name you trust, competitive hourly pay, and a genuine shot at a permanent career, our Peak Warehouse Sorter position is open and ready for you right now. No lengthy application process, no multi-week waiting period — UPS peak hiring is designed for speed because the packages do not wait for anyone.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I applied on a Monday and was working by Thursday. The onboarding process at UPS during peak is extremely fast and well-organized — they know how to bring large numbers of people in quickly without it feeling chaotic. The pay was better than I expected for a seasonal warehouse job hiring immediately, the overtime was genuinely available, and I was offered a permanent position before the season even ended." - Former Peak Sorter, Now Permanent Associate, Seattle, WA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorter, you join our package center sort operation during the November-through-January holiday window, processing the highest package volumes of the year with speed and accuracy that keeps America's holiday delivery commitments intact.

  • Rapid Onboarding & Immediate Start: Complete UPS's streamlined peak-season onboarding process — safety orientation, method training, and first sort shift — within days of your offer letter, with your first paycheck arriving the following week without exception.
  • Peak Volume Sorting: Sort dramatically elevated holiday package volumes on high-speed conveyor systems, reading destination routing codes and diverting parcels accurately to outbound lanes at full production rate within your first few shifts on the job.
  • Overtime Priority Access: As a seasonal sorter during peak, you have first access to available overtime hours during the highest-volume weeks — Black Friday, Cyber Monday, pre-Christmas — generating a seasonal paycheck significantly larger than standard hours provide.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorters receive competitive hourly pay, weekly direct-deposit paychecks, and significant overtime availability throughout the peak window. Associates who demonstrate performance and reliability during the seasonal period receive formal permanent hire consideration — converting a temporary position into a Teamsters union career complete with medical, dental, vision, pension, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition benefits.

jobs.title: Chicago Contract:UPS Preload Package Handler
jobs.description:
Position in Chicago, IL

Snapshot

  • Employer: United Parcel Service (UPS) (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Position: UPS Preload Package Handler (Flexible/Contract, Chicago)
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our United Parcel Service (UPS) team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Warehousing And Logistics industry.

Salary and Benefits

  • Compensation: $1.5k-$2.5k/Month (approx. $24k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

Build the Route Before the Sun Comes Up

Every morning, thousands of UPS drivers jump into perfectly loaded trucks, turn the key, and hit the road. That seamless execution is only possible because of the UPS Preload Package Handler. Operating during the very early morning hours (typically 3:00 AM to 8:00 AM), you are the architect of the delivery route. You will stand inside the back of the brown package cars, catching packages off a high-speed conveyor belt and loading them sequentially based on the driver's route map. If you want a fast-paced, intensely physical part-time job that provides incredible union benefits and frees up your entire day, this is the most critical warehouse role at UPS.

Preload Operations

  • High-Speed Package Sorting: Read alphanumeric routing codes on packages flying down the conveyor belt. You must quickly identify which packages belong to the 3 or 4 trucks you are assigned to load.
  • Sequential Truck Loading: This is a game of high-stakes Tetris. You must physically load the packages onto the specific interior shelves of the package car in the exact order the driver will deliver them, ensuring the heaviest boxes are safely secured on the floor.
  • Extreme Physical Conditioning: Skip the gym forever. You will be continuously twisting, bending, reaching, and lifting packages weighing up to 70 pounds for 4 to 5 hours straight in a fast-paced, loud, industrial environment.
  • Quality Control: Identify leaking, crushed, or mislabeled packages and pull them off the line for the problem-solve team before they are loaded onto the delivery truck.

The Part-Time Union Advantage

The UPS Preload position is legendary for its benefits. Even as a part-time employee, after a brief waiting period, you receive the same zero-premium, top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance as full-time drivers. You are protected by the Teamsters union, receive regular wage increases, and get access to the "Earn and Learn" program, which provides massive tuition assistance for college students. Most importantly, Preload is the primary waiting list to become a highly-paid UPS Delivery Driver.

Requirements

Must be at least 18 years old. No driving license is required for this warehouse role. You must possess extreme physical stamina and athletic endurance to handle continuous heavy lifting up to 70 lbs. You must have the discipline to wake up and work extremely early morning hours (e.g., 3:00 AM starts). A reliable work ethic and ability to pass a background check are mandatory.
